programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Adel, Georgia. The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Sauquoit, New York. When a beloved chiropractor in Sauquoit, N. Y., dies suddenly under strange circumstances, investigators discover she's been murdered with a rare poison; the killer could only be someone she knew closely, and the case divides the town.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: St. Augustine, Florida. A young woman in St. Augustine, Fla., with everything to live for is found shot to death with the gun belonging to her boyfriend, a deputy sheriff; he says it was suicide, but her family believes it was murder.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Cookeville, Tennessee. When an immigrant couple who settled in the Tennessee town of Cookeville is executed in their sleep and their house set on fire, investigators identify a suspect with motive; in their rush to make an arrest, they may have gotten the wrong man.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Shelbyville, Kentucky. In rural Shelbyville, Ky., a body is found in the river; years go by until the police catch the killer, but some in town question if the suspect is even capable of committing the crime.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: Rockville / Ellington, Connecticut. When a 22-year-old dancer goes missing, the men of the neighboring town who frequented the club she worked at become the suspect pool; wealth and status may protect a killer; a determined police officer works the case.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Dallas, Ga.. In this true-crime story, after a woman is found shot in her bathroom, officials launch a death investigation to determine if it was suicide -- as her husband claimed -- or murder; years later, the case remains open, and the town still has questions.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Pocomoke City, Md.. In this true-crime story, a young single mother disappears without a trace; an investigation suggests she abandoned her children, while her family spends years proving she was murdered and finding her killers.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Angier, N. C.. In this true crime story, a man claims he shot his daughter's estranged husband, Christian Griggs, in self-defense -- but after investigators close the case, Christian's family discovers evidence that the killing was not justified.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Iaeger, W. Va.. In this true-crime story, a beloved town doctor perishes in a deadly house fire -- which investigators conclude was arson; but after securing a murder conviction, the prosecutor doubts his own evidence and joins the fight to free an innocent man.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Atwater, Ohio. In this true-crime story, cold-case investigators looking into a double murder elicit a series of confessions from a group of teens; years later, the teens recant their statements; aggressive tactics may have sent an innocent man to death row.

programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Turlock, California. A criminal defense attorney known for uncovering corruption finds himself on trial; accused of a complex murder-for-hire plot, along with eight others, he fights to clear his name and show the holes in the state's case.

programme.desc: It Couldn't Happen Here: Royse City, Texas. A couple are found brutally murdered in their home; investigators learn that the last person to see them alive had secrets of his own; some question whether prejudice led police to arrest the wrong man.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: State College, Pennsylvania. A college town is turned upside down when a young man is convicted of his friend's murder; after more than three decades behind bars, previously concealed evidence is uncovered that could prove the convicted man's innocence.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: Brownstown, Indiana. A desperate single mother is arrested for shoplifting and thrown into a small-town jail; less than three months later she winds up dead after her pleas for help are dismissed for 19 hours.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
programme.desc: Love County, Oklahoma. After escaping a car chase with police, a teenage girl and a young man go missing on Chickasaw land; competing jurisdictions, a scandalized sheriff and cover-up accusations complicate the families' search for answers.

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here

programme.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here

programme.desc: Look Into My Eyes: Absorb Attention. At North Port High School in Florida, three students die within months of each other; as the community learns more, they discover a common thread: all three students were hypnotized by their principal, Dr. George Kenney, not long before they died.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: Look Into My Eyes: Bypass the Critical. Dr. George Kenney begins to reveal his side of the story; as details emerge about the deaths and Marcus, Wesley and Brittany's parents speak out, an investigation into Kenney's hypnosis practice begins; the North Port community grows suspicious.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: Look Into My Eyes: Activate the Unconscious. The press catches wind of the story, and it captures headlines worldwide; Dr. Kenney is asked to leave North Port High, and as the criminal trial heats up, the community is split on his culpability; a student comes forward with a new perspective.

programme.title: True Crime Story
programme.desc: Look Into My Eyes: The Outcome. Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

programme.desc: The Secret Box; Band Geeks. Not knowing the contents of Pat's secret box drives SpongeBob crazy; Squidward lies to an old rival about having a band.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Ghost; Pups Save a Show. When a ghost appears at the Lookout, the Pups and Chase have a stakeout; the Pups put on a Medieval play in the town square.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow. Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga. When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Stop a Topiary Tal; Pups Save a Hum-Ball. Mr. Park has a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse; Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups vs. Ouchy Paws; Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party. Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter. Farmer Al has a new ice resurfacing machine, but when it goes haywire, it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to help; when the Turbots accidentally bring a porcupine to Adventure Bay, the prickly critter gets loose and causes trouble.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Rubble-Double; Pups Save a Clown. Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Moto Pup: Pups Save a Sneezy Chase; Moto Pups: Rescue at Twisty Top Mesa. Moto Pups must rescue the baddies off the Twisty Top Mesa; Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, and he's trapped with the Ruff Ruff Pack.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists. Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Movie Monster - S5E31. Envious Mayor Humdinger tries to draw the Adventure Bay Monster Movie production to Foggy Bottom by commandeering the mechanical movie monster, but he can't control the fire-breathing robot. (12/15/2018)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show. The pups enlist a kitten named Marble to go inside a pipe and fix the blockage; when a traveling basketball team fails to show up, the construction pups gear up and put on their own basketball show.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Aqua Pups Save the Reef; Aqua Pups Stop a Giant Squid. The Aqua Pups rescue Coral, Moby and McSquidly from a submarine before it crashes into a delicate reef; the Aqua Pups must save the Merpups' golden orb release when Moby lures a Giant Squid into Puplantis.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Mountain Surfers; Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away From Home. A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Skye's Road Trip Rescue - S11E44. Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals. (05/03/2025)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mission PAW: Royally Spooked!; Pups Save Monkey-Dinger. The pups go to Barkingburg to investigate when the Princess thinks she has seen a ghost; while on safari with Carlos and Tracker, Mayor Humdinger steals a magic mask.

programme.desc: The One With Ross's Tan - S10E3. Rachel and Joey nervously anticipate their first real date; Monica and Phoebe try to avoid an obnoxious friend with a fake British accent; Ross emerges from a tanning booth with a two-toned appearance. (10/09/2003)

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: The One With the Birth Mother - S10E9. A prospective birth mother labors under a misconception about Monica and Chandler's respective occupations. (01/08/2004)
